## prompt-2-draft-paper

*Generated by Process A from [`../prompts/prompt-paper.md`](../prompts/prompt-paper.md),
adapting `trial-protocol/sub-prompts/prompt-2-draft-protocol.md` to the paper build
(paper v1.0, repository v4.2.0). Runs in stage `trial-documents/draft-paper/`.*

Author the **Stage 2 draft (scaffold)** of the paper *Phase 1 Pancreatic Cancer
Trial Efficient LLM Document Generations* into `trial-documents/draft-paper/`.

**Goal.** The draft is the paper's first LaTeX files: it lays out every paper
section and carries bracketed `[DRAFTING INSTRUCTION]` pointers (the `\draftinstr`
macro) that name the exact `physical-ai-oncology-trials` repository files and
directories the full stage will process. The draft compiles on Overleaf with
pdfLaTeX but is intentionally a scaffold, not full prose.

**Paper template.** Build on `trial-documents/inputs/llm-adoption` (the *Oncology
Trial PI LLM Adoption Guide*, paper v1.0 here) as the paper template, but add a
Keywords section and a Rights and Permissions (CC) section in the back matter. The
paper has many more sections and pages than the template. Learn image, white-space,
and paper-formatting code strategies from
`trial-protocol/final-protocol/publication` (do not use that publication as the
template). Keep black body text.

**Files (Rule 6, one commit each).** `main.tex`, `paperstyle.sty`,
`references.bib`, and `README.md`; then one commit per section `.tex`:
- `sections/sec-01-abstract.tex` - Abstract and Keywords.
- `sections/sec-02-introduction.tex` - Introduction (with the three OUTLINE
  themes: patients enrolled cannot wait; effective verifications; patient lives
  extended).
- `sections/sec-03-methods.tex` - Methods (repository-based LLM, sub-prompt
  schedule, mermaid -> draft -> full -> final, auto-commit, the document-type and
  industry-workflow sources).
- `sections/sec-04-results.tex` - Results (the six ACCELERATION targets; iteration
  cadence; figure grounding; name-matching verifications; prior single-prompt
  multi-file developments).
- `sections/sec-05-discussion.tex` - Discussion (benefit greater than risk;
  admin/prep compression; prior developments as evidence).
- `sections/sec-06-limitations.tex` - Limitations and Future Work.
- `sections/sec-07-conclusions.tex` - Conclusions.
- `sections/sec-08-references-backmatter.tex` - References and Back Matter
  (Acknowledgments, Author and ORCID, Ethical Disclosures, Data Availability,
  Rights and Permissions (CC), Cite This Article).
The Table of Contents is generated in `main.tex` via `\tableofcontents`.

**Bracketed instructions.** Each `\draftinstr` must name the precise files for the
full stage: the 24 `mermaid/fig-NN-*.md` figures; the four research sources in
`research/document-types` and `research/industry-workflow`; the author works in
`inputs/references.bib`; the main documents (the 2030 60-second PDAC simulation
10.5281/zenodo.20196639, H. R. 9510 v5.0 10.5281/zenodo.20619762, the national
platform 10.5281/zenodo.19244918, and the five DARAXONRASIB entries); the Phase 2
directory `trial-phase-2`; and the cited single-prompt repositories.

**Commit schedule (Rules 6, 7, 8).** One commit per file in real time (10+
commits). The second-to-last commit fixes all errors across the draft files. The
last commit writes `sections/README.md`, `output-draft-paper.md`, and the
`draft-paper-LaTeX.zip` Overleaf bundle. Do not stall, ask questions, or go into
plan mode.
